_comment: ENSjs-v2 Sepolia contract addresses for the local Panoptes indexer. Mount as CONTRACTS_PATH=/app/config/contracts.json
_source: Addresses are ensL1Contracts[sepolia] from @ensdomains/ensjs/chain — the same config the apps read, so this file cannot drift from what they talk to. Regenerate from there rather than hand-editing. Exceptions, both verified on-chain: root_registry comes from ethRegistry.getParent(), which ensjs does not expose; registry_datastore / l2_registry_datastore are vestigial (contracts-v2 no longer has a RegistryDatastore) and are left as-is.
_verified: 2026-09-16 against the Sepolia fork, after the 2026-09-15 redeploy (#1168, ensjs 029b5f9), which moved public_resolver, eth_registry, migration_helper and both migration controllers. Regenerated from ensL1Contracts[sepolia]; the harness case 'panoptes: the indexer is watching the contracts the apps actually talk to' is what caught the drift. Note a redeploy also invalidates whatever the indexer already stored, so the panoptes-data volume must be wiped, not just restarted — a running indexer on a stale DB answers 200 with zero rows, which the UI renders as a confident negative. Before 2026-08-10, eth_registry pointed at 0xdedb9291… (a superseded deployment), so Panoptes skipped every event from the live registry as an unknown contract and the portal's roles tables rendered empty — see e2e/docs/e2e-defects.md.
